tours.reasoning_after:
Measured facts show TP5 signal degraded (0.4 Vpp distorted vs 2.0 clean) while DC is nominal (0.0V), so fault is on signal. Dichotomy on signal: TP3 signal nominal (0.2 Vpp clean) eliminates upstream C1, TP4 signal abnormal (0.5 Vpp distorted) is first signal anomaly, accusing U1 stage. Check of operating conditions: U1 supply TP1=5.2V vs 9.0V nominal abnormal, input DC TP3=2.6V vs 4.5V abnormal, bias TP2=2.6V vs 4.5V abnormal tracking supply/2, so U1 merely suffers. First abnormal in supply direction is TP1, whose source is PS1; downstream R1, U1, C2 all suffer from already-abnormal input.
HYPOTHESES: PS1
DIAGNOSTIC: PS1 - supply rail TP1 low at 5.2V explains proportional bias drop and distorted low gain, with nominal signal at TP3 and degraded signal from TP4 onward; recommended confirmation test: substitute known-good 9V supply for PS1 and verify TP1 returns to 9.0V and TP4/TP5 return to 2.0 Vpp clean.
